research.locationNote: Ramhan Island, Abu Dhabi; hotel and residences occupy the inner waterfront.
overview: The developer describes 125 private residences. Hotel accommodation is separate from the residential collection.
Hospitality services are advertised; confirm inclusions and charges before purchase.
research.priceNote: Found advertises entry prices from AED 3.1 million; no dated developer price list was verified.
research.paymentNote: Broker terms conflict: Found publishes 5/45/50; Luxhabitat publishes 10/40/50. Obtain the applicable developer schedule.
research.handoverNote: Brokers indicate Q4 2028. No developer completion undertaking was retrieved.
